card.name: Hepatitis C protease inhibitor mentions
card.fires_on: Words just before a hepatitis C protease inhibitor drug name, such as the 'CV' in HCV, 'with', 'inhibitor' or an opening parenthesis. It appears in drug-interaction text listing HCV protease inhibitors like boceprevir, telaprevir or NS3/4A inhibitors.

modes.label: Inside HCV protease inhibitor phrase
modes.description: The marked word is part of 'HCV protease inhibitor' or the bracket right after it, before the drug name.

modes.label: Before NS3/4A or boceprevir/telaprevir
modes.description: A linking word right before naming an NS3/4A protease inhibitor or an HCV drug in hepatitis C treatment advice.
modes.example: recipients. A 16-week treatment duration is recommended in genotype 1-infected patients who are NS5A inhibitor-experienced without prior treatment with<< an>> NS3/4A protease inhibitor

card.writes: It seems to push toward NS-style terms like NS3, NS5A and genotype, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to name a hepatitis C protease inhibitor drug or its NS3/4A target.
